hypothesis: A slender clean stalk and removal of the bulbous branch ends should make the bloom less cartoon-heavy and give it more breathing room.
mutation: White overpaint on two offset stalk paths; white contacts remove the bulky leaf tips. Repaint the unchanged red petal contacts to restore any overlap at the flower/stem junction, retaining the small yellow centre.
acceptance: Stalk must be visibly slimmer and continuous, with clean white surroundings and intact bloom. No green ghosts, amputated blobs or damaged petals; reject if simplifying the plant worsens the composition.
